statement: Lambda's public catalog lists no H200, GB200, or AMD MI300X/MI355X on-demand capacity as of 2026-08-24
why: A major independent cloud offering no alternative-vendor accelerators on its public menu suggests non-incumbent supply is still not reaching self-serve renters at scale.

impact.mechanism: Absence of alternative-vendor and newest-generation parts from a public rental catalog indicates that alternative accelerator supply is not yet available through self-serve channels, keeping renters dependent on incumbent parts.

evidence.excerpt: H200, GB200, and MI300X/MI355X are NOT listed anywhere on this page as of the observation date.

confidence.basis: Absence of a listing on one vendor's public page is weak evidence; capacity may exist under reserved or contract terms not shown publicly.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: CoreWeave, Lambda (Lambda Labs)
